papers.title: Chronological age and failure to rescue after colorectal cancer surgery: A multicentre cohort study
papers.authors: Cwaliński T, Kazanowski M, Piątkowski J, Ciesielski M, Januszkiewicz M, Bigus Z
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Whether advancing chronological age is associated more strongly with serious postoperative events or with survival after an event remains uncertain.
AIMS: To compare the association of chronological age with major postoperative events and failure to rescue after colorectal cancer surgery.
METHODS: We analyzed 1,124 adults treated at five Polish centers between January 2022 and August 2025. Major events were Clavien-Dindo ≥grade IIIa; failure to rescue was cumulative 90-day death after such an event. Chronological age was analysed per 10-year increase. Multivariable logistic regression examined major events and Firth regression examined failure to rescue.
RESULTS: Major events occurred in 145 patients; failure to rescue was evaluable in 134 and occurred in 24. Chronological age was not associated with major events (adjusted odds ratio per decade 1.09, 95% confidence interval 0.89-1.33) or nonfatal major morbidity. Failure-to-rescue odds increased per decade (odds ratio 2.02, 95% confidence interval 1.21-3.63); model-standardized probabilities were 11.1% at age 65 and 32.5% at age 85 years. Sensitivity analyses were directionally consistent, but the interval included no association when every model-eligible missing post-event outcome was assigned to death.
DISCUSSION: The chronological-age gradient was concentrated in survival after a serious event. Frailty and physiological reserve were not measured; reduced reserve remains a plausible explanation rather than a demonstrated mechanism.
CONCLUSIONS: Chronological age may help identify patients who warrant intensified postoperative surveillance and early escalation, while formal geriatric and frailty assessment remains necessary to characterize biological vulnerability.
papers.title_zh: 實齡與大腸直腸癌手術後「搶救失敗」之關聯：多中心世代研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：實際年齡增加究竟與嚴重術後事件的發生較相關，還是與事件發生後的存活率較相關，目前尚不清楚。目的：比較實際年齡與大腸直腸癌手術後重大術後事件及搶救失敗（failure to rescue）之關聯。方法：分析2022年1月至2025年8月間，波蘭五個醫學中心收治的1,124名成人病患。重大事件定義為Clavien-Dindo分級≥IIIa；搶救失敗定義為發生此類事件後90天內累積死亡。以每增加10歲分析實際年齡，多變量邏輯回歸分析重大事件，Firth回歸分析搶救失敗。結果：145名病人發生重大事件；搶救失敗可評估者134人，其中24人發生。實際年齡與重大事件無關（校正後每十年勝算比1.09，95%信賴區間0.89-1.33），亦與非致命性重大併發症無關。搶救失敗之勝算隨每十年增加而上升（勝算比2.02，95%信賴區間1.21-3.63）；模型標準化機率顯示65歲時為11.1%，85歲時為32.5%。敏感度分析方向一致，但當所有模型可納入的缺失事件後結果皆被歸類為死亡時，信賴區間則涵蓋無相關性。討論：年齡梯度效應集中於嚴重事件發生後的存活率。本研究未測量衰弱（frailty）與生理儲備，儲備降低仍僅為合理推測機轉，而非已證實的機制。結論：實際年齡或可協助辨識需加強術後監測與及早升級處置的病人，但仍需正式老年醫學與衰弱評估以描述生物學脆弱性。
papers.score_reason: 概念有趣（年齡影響存活而非併發症發生率），但FTR事件僅24例、信賴區間寬，且最壞情境敏感度分析使結果失去顯著性，證據尚不穩固。
papers.relevance_why: 主題為大腸直腸癌手術高齡病人照護，但屬觀察性假說生成研究，未直接改變手術適應症或術式選擇。

papers.title: Multipathway pharmacological interventions targeting liver-derived immune resistance in colorectal cancer liver metastasis
papers.authors: Chen M, Qin S, Zhan Y, Wang Q
papers.abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors provide durable benefit in mismatch repair-deficient colorectal cancer, but most microsatellite-stable tumors remain resistant, particularly in the presence of liver metastases. Immune resistance in colorectal cancer liver metastasis reflects both baseline MSS-CRC mechanisms, including low neoantigenicity, limited T-cell priming and tumor-intrinsic immune exclusion, and liver-specific or liver-amplified mechanisms, including tolerogenic antigen presentation by hepatic resident cells, macrophage-mediated loss of tumor-reactive T cells, and hepatic stromal, vascular and metabolic remodeling. Across early-phase and retrospective studies, responses to checkpoint-based combinations have been observed more often in patients without active liver metastases, but these exploratory subgroup findings do not yet establish independent predictive value or clinical causality. Antiangiogenic agents, multikinase inhibitors, myeloid- and stromal-targeted therapies, innate immune activation, and liver-directed interventions may partially overcome these barriers, but single-pathway strategies have shown limited efficacy. This Mini Review summarizes the mechanisms and clinical evidence of liver-mediated immune resistance and proposes organ-informed, mechanism-matched therapeutic strategies for colorectal cancer liver metastasis.

papers.abstract_zh: 免疫檢查點抑制劑在錯配修復缺陷型大腸直腸癌中提供持久效益，但大多數微衛星穩定型（MSS）腫瘤仍具抗性，尤其在合併肝轉移時更為明顯。大腸直腸癌肝轉移的免疫抗性反映了基礎MSS-CRC機制（包括低新抗原性、有限的T細胞致敏作用、腫瘤內在性免疫排除）以及肝臟特異性或肝臟放大的機制（包括肝臟常駐細胞之耐受性抗原呈現、巨噬細胞介導之腫瘤反應性T細胞喪失、以及肝臟間質、血管與代謝重塑）。在早期臨床試驗與回溯性研究中，無活動性肝轉移的患者對檢查點相關聯合療法的反應較常見，但這些探索性次群組發現尚未確立獨立預測價值或臨床因果關係。抗血管新生藥物、多重激酶抑制劑、骨髓與間質靶向療法、先天免疫活化及肝臟導向介入可能部分克服這些障礙，但單一路徑策略的療效有限。本迷你綜述總結了肝臟介導免疫抗性的機制與臨床證據，並提出以器官為基礎、機制匹配的大腸直腸癌肝轉移治療策略。

papers.title: Challenges and opportunities facing inflammatory bowel disease in Sub-Saharan Africa: towards a contextually relevant research and practice agenda
papers.authors: Cooper S, Watermeyer G, Levin D, Mhlaba Z, Davidson K, Bernstein C
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), comprising Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, has traditionally been considered a disease of Western, industrialized countries. Over the past few decades, however, many Sub-Saharan African (SSA) countries have experienced significant increases in cases. Yet, IBD remains highly neglected in SSA with most research conducted in high-income settings and treatment guidelines geared towards these settings. An emerging body of research on the sub-continent is highlighting several unique realities, dilemmas, and priorities facing IBD, and the need for evidence-based approaches that are more locally relevant and contextually tailored. In this viewpoint article we synthesize the challenges facing IBD in SSA and propose a research and practice agenda for addressing these, building on several promising initiatives already under way. Ultimately, we make a call to the international IBD community, researchers, funders, and policymakers to recognize the importance of IBD in SSA and join efforts to remedy global disparities in the quality, accessibility, and equity of IBD care.
papers.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲發炎性腸道疾病面臨的挑戰與機會：邁向具情境relevance的研究與實務議程
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），包含克隆氏症與潰瘍性結腸炎，傳統上被認為是西方工業化國家的疾病。然而，過去數十年間，許多撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）國家的病例數顯著增加。儘管如此，IBD 在 SSA 仍高度被忽視，大多數研究於高收入地區進行，治療指引也多針對這些地區設計。該次大陸上新興的研究凸顯出 IBD 面臨的數個獨特現實、困境與優先議題，以及建立更具在地關聯性、情境化實證方法的必要性。本篇觀點文章綜整 SSA 地區 IBD 面臨的挑戰，並基於若干已在進行中的具前景計畫，提出因應的研究與實務議程。最終，我們呼籲國際 IBD 社群、研究者、資助者與政策制定者正視 IBD 在 SSA 的重要性，共同致力改善全球 IBD 照護品質、可及性與公平性的落差。

papers.title: Revisiting Cell Death in Colorectal Cancer: The Rise of Ferroptosis as a Therapeutic Opportunity
papers.authors: Altamimi A, Elemam N, Kalady M, Talaat I
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a global health concern and a leading cause of cancer mortality, where therapeutic resistance persists as the central barrier to sustained response. Most conventional therapies rely on apoptosis, but CRC frequently resists through p53 alterations, anti-apoptotic BCL-2 upregulation, and drug efflux mechanisms. Here, we explore unconventional cell death pathways, focusing on ferroptosis, as a strategy to overcome apoptosis-dependent therapeutic resistance in CRC. We discussed the molecular mechanisms of ferroptosis, including GPX4 blockade, iron dysregulation, and lipid metabolism remodeling, and emphasized their implications for drug-resistant CRC. Then, necroptosis, pyroptosis, and autophagy were discussed in relation to their crosstalk with ferroptosis. Preclinical models show that ferroptosis inducers (e.g., erastin, RSL3, talaroconvolutin) selectively kill chemoresistant CRC, including KRAS-mutant CRC, and potentiate the efficacy of conventional regimens. The therapeutic duality of autophagy, pyroptosis, and necroptosis in CRC is discussed, with emphasis on ferroptosis's ability to circumvent traditional mechanisms of resistance. Yet, clinical translation is hindered by insufficient pharmacokinetics, systemic toxicity, limited biomarker availability, tumor heterogeneity, compensatory antioxidant pathways, and the need for safer delivery platforms. We propose that ferroptosis is most likely to enter CRC therapy through rational combinations, biomarker-guided patient selection, and tumor-targeted delivery platforms rather than as a stand-alone cytotoxic strategy.

papers.title_zh: 重新審視大腸直腸癌中的細胞死亡：鐵死亡（Ferroptosis）作為治療契機的崛起
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）仍是全球健康隱憂及癌症死亡主因，其中治療抗性持續是維持治療反應的核心障礙。多數傳統療法仰賴細胞凋亡（apoptosis），但CRC常透過p53突變、抗凋亡蛋白BCL-2上調及藥物外排機制產生抗性。本文探討非傳統細胞死亡路徑，聚焦於鐵死亡（ferroptosis），作為克服CRC中依賴細胞凋亡之治療抗性的策略。我們討論了鐵死亡的分子機轉，包括GPX4阻斷、鐵代謝失調及脂質代謝重塑，並強調其對抗藥性CRC的意義。接著討論了necroptosis、pyroptosis及自噬（autophagy）與鐵死亡的交互作用。臨床前模型顯示，鐵死亡誘導劑（如erastin、RSL3、talaroconvolutin）能選擇性殺死化療抗性CRC細胞（包括KRAS突變型CRC），並增強傳統療法之療效。文中亦討論了自噬、pyroptosis及necroptosis在CRC中的雙重治療性角色，並強調鐵死亡規避傳統抗藥機轉的能力。然而，臨床轉譯仍受限於藥物動力學不足、全身性毒性、生物標誌物有限、腫瘤異質性、代償性抗氧化路徑，以及對更安全遞送平台的需求。我們提出，鐵死亡最可能透過合理的藥物組合、生物標誌物導向之病人篩選，以及腫瘤標靶遞送平台進入CRC治療，而非作為單一細胞毒性策略。

papers.title: SIRT3-Dependent Actions of Berberine: From Molecular Therapies to Toxicity
papers.journal_full: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
papers.authors: Shackebaei D, Miraghaee S, Farhadi F, Akbarzadeh A, Yarmohammadi F
papers.abstract: Berberine, an alkaloid with broad bioactive properties, exerts its pleiotropic effects by modulating SIRT3, a mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase. This review examines the dual role of SIRT3 as a target of berberine in the management of various disorders while also addressing its associated toxicological profiles. The antihyperglycemic effects of berberine are mediated through SIRT3 inhibition, which promotes hyperacetylation of complex I subunits, degradation of MPC1, an increased AMP/ATP ratio, AMPK activation, and suppression of PEPCK1, collectively resulting in the inhibition of gluconeogenesis. In contrast, the hypolipidemic, cardioprotective, and hepatoprotective effects of berberine are associated with SIRT3 activation, which facilitating adipose tissue remodeling, enhancing β-oxidation in NAFLD, promoting lipophagy in diabetic cardiomyopathy, and mitigates doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity. Furthermore, berberine exhibits antitumor duality, exerting contrasting effects in colorectal cancer and hepatoma models, and demonstrates versatile mitochondrial metabolic reprogramming in polycystic ovarian syndrome. Notably, ocular toxicity associated with berberine has been linked to SIRT3 inhibition in photoreceptors cells. Overall, the therapeutic versatility of berberine is fundamentally associated with its context-dependent modulation of SIRT3, positioning it as a promising mitochondrial epigenetics modulator for conditions such as metabolic syndrome, NAFLD, and DCM. However, its therapeutic application must be carefully balanced against organ-specific toxicity risks.
papers.title_zh: 小檀堿（Berberine）依賴SIRT3的作用：從分子治療到毒性
papers.abstract_zh: 小檀堿（Berberine）是一種具有廣泛生物活性的生物鹼，其多效性作用是透過調節SIRT3（一種線粒體NAD+依賴性去乙醯化酶）來實現的。本綜述探討SIRT3作為小檀堿在多種疾病治療中的雙重角色靶點，同時也探討其相關毒理學特徵。小檀堿的抗高血糖效果是透過SIRT3抑制來介導的，這會促進complex I次單元的過度乙醯化、MPC1的降解、增加AMP/ATP比值、活化AMPK，以及抑制PEPCK1，共同導致糖質新生的抑制。相反地，小檀堿的降血脂、心臟保護及肝臟保護效果則與SIRT3活化有關，這會促進脂肪組織重塑、增強NAFLD中的β氧化、促進糖尿病心肌病變中的脂噬作用，並減輕doxorubicin引起的心臟毒性。此外，小檀堿展現出抗腫瘤的雙重性，在大腸直腸癌與肝癌模型中表現出相反的作用，並在多囊性卵巢症候群中展現多樣性的線粒體代謝重編程。值得注意的是，小檀堿相關的眼毒性已被連結至光受體細胞中的SIRT3抑制。總體而言，小檀堿的治療多樣性從根本上與其對SIRT3的情境依賴性調節有關，使其成為代謝症候群、NAFLD及糖尿病心肌病變等疾病的一種有潛力的線粒體表觀遺傳調節劑。然而，其治療應用必須審慎權衡器官特異性的毒性風險。

papers.title: Intraoperative margin assessment in colorectal cancer via AI-enhanced multiphoton microscopy
papers.authors: Lai Q, Lin Z, Xi G, He J, Wang G, Zhang J
papers.abstract:
SIGNIFICANCE: Identifying residual tumors at the resection margins is crucial for individuals undergoing colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery. Accurate margin assessment can help minimize residual tumor while avoiding unnecessary removal of healthy tissue.
AIM: This study uses label-free multiphoton microscopy to visualize collagen architecture and develops a feature-enhanced deep-learning model to distinguish CRC from margin-adjacent normal tissue.
APPROACH: Margin-adjacent normal and carcinoma tissues were imaged using multiphoton microscopy, and 142 quantitative collagen features were extracted from SHG images. We propose PVT-Enhanced, a feature-fusion model that integrates handcrafted collagen features with deep image features derived from PVTv2-b5 through an attention-based fusion strategy. Its performance was compared with LASSO-LR, three convolutional neural networks, and image-only PVTv2-b5.
RESULTS: SHG imaging showed relatively coherent fiber orientation, longer and more continuous collagen fibers, and higher fiber density in margin-adjacent normal tissue, whereas carcinoma tissue showed more disorganized orientation, shorter and more fragmented fibers, and lower fiber density. The PVT-Enhanced model achieved an accuracy of 86.9%, an AUC of 0.923, and a specificity of 96.4%. Only 5 of 137 margin-adjacent normal images were misclassified as CRC.
CONCLUSIONS: Our findings suggest that the PVT-Enhanced framework combined with SHG imaging allows accurate, rapid, and label-free tissue characterization that may support intraoperative margin assessment in CRC surgery.
papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌術中切緣評估：AI 強化多光子顯微術
papers.abstract_zh:
意義：對接受大腸直腸癌（CRC）手術的病人而言，辨識切除邊緣是否殘留腫瘤至關重要。準確的切緣評估有助於減少腫瘤殘留，同時避免不必要地切除健康組織。
目的：本研究利用免標記多光子顯微術觀察膠原蛋白結構，並開發一個特徵增強深度學習模型，以區分 CRC 與切緣鄰近正常組織。
方法：使用多光子顯微術對切緣鄰近正常組織與癌組織進行影像擷取，並從二次諧波（SHG）影像中提取 142 個量化膠原特徵。我們提出 PVT-Enhanced，一種融合手工膠原特徵與 PVTv2-b5 深度影像特徵的特徵融合模型，透過注意力機制進行融合，並與 LASSO-LR、三種卷積神經網路、以及僅使用影像的 PVTv2-b5 進行效能比較。
結果：SHG 影像顯示切緣鄰近正常組織具有較一致的纖維方向、較長且連續的膠原纖維、以及較高的纖維密度；而癌組織則呈現較紊亂的方向、較短且破碎的纖維、以及較低的纖維密度。PVT-Enhanced 模型達到 86.9% 準確率、AUC 0.923、特異度 96.4%。137 張切緣鄰近正常影像中僅 5 張被誤判為 CRC。
結論：研究結果顯示 PVT-Enhanced 架構結合 SHG 影像可進行準確、快速、免標記的組織特徵分析，可能有助於 CRC 手術中的術中切緣評估。

papers.title: Robotic Beyond Total Mesorectal Excision With Synchronous Perineal Flap Reconstruction: Feasibility and Early Outcomes
papers.journal_full: The international journal of medical robotics + computer assisted surgery : MRCAS
papers.authors: Alharbi A, Iqbal M, Dowsett D, Rudge E, Shah H, Kapur S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Advanced rectal and anal malignancies often require dissections beyond total mesorectal planes for improved oncological outcomes. While minimally invasive techniques facilitate this approach, they result in larger perineal defects, creating reconstructive challenges. Robotic-assisted surgery enhances precision, visualisation, and ergonomics, potentially optimising outcomes. However, data on robotics beyond total mesorectal excision (bTME) remain limited. This study evaluated robotic bTME and synchronous gracilis or PAP (profunda artery perforator) flap reconstruction.
METHODS: This retrospective case series reviewed 10 patients with locally advanced or recurrent anorectal cancer who underwent elective robotic bTME with synchronous perineal gracilis or PAP flap reconstruction.
RESULTS: Median operative time was 465 minutes. Gracilis flap harvest was concurrent. No major flap-related complications or reoperations. R0 resection was achieved in 80%. At 1-year, local recurrence was 0%, distant metastases 30%, and disease-free survival 70%.
CONCLUSION: Robotics bTME with synchronous gracilis or PAP flap reconstruction is feasible, efficient, and oncologically safe.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：晚期直腸與肛門惡性腫瘤常需進行超越全直腸繫膜平面的切除以改善腫瘤學結果。雖然微創技術有助於此類手術，但會造成較大的會陰部缺損，帶來重建上的挑戰。機器手臂輔助手術可提升精確度、視野與人體工學，可能有助於優化結果。然而，關於機器手臂超全直腸繫膜切除術（bTME）的資料仍有限。本研究評估機器手臂bTME合併同期薄肌（gracilis）或股深動脈穿通枝（PAP）皮瓣重建。方法：此回溯性病例系列回顧了10位接受擇期機器手臂bTME合併同期會陰部薄肌或PAP皮瓣重建的局部晚期或復發性肛門直腸癌患者。結果：手術時間中位數為465分鐘。薄肌皮瓣採取為同時進行。無重大皮瓣相關併發症或再次手術。R0切除率達80%。1年時，局部復發率為0%，遠端轉移率為30%，無病存活率為70%。結論：機器手臂bTME合併同期薄肌或PAP皮瓣重建具可行性、具效率，且在腫瘤學上安全。

papers.title: A protocol for the development of a core descriptor and core outcome set for acute left-sided diverticulitis
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: CODD‐ Collaborative for Outcomes in Diverticular Disease
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Diverticulitis is a common emergency general surgical condition that affects patients worldwide. Research remains heterogeneous, meaning the provision of high-quality, evidence-based care for these patients remains a challenge. We aimed therefore to complete a core outcome and core descriptor set for acute left-sided diverticulitis.
METHODS: An international team set out to develop a COS and CDS using Core Outcome Measures in Effectiveness Trials (COMET) guidance. The production of a longlist of domains will initially be completed. This will initially involve a systematic review to identify different descriptors and outcomes. Patient engagement through a minimum of two focus groups with patients will be completed to ensure the completeness of the final lists. The final lists of descriptors and outcomes will then be prioritised utilising a sequential, multi-round international electronic Delphi of healthcare professionals, with patients contributing to the COS development. A final consensus meeting will then be held to ratify the final components of the COS.
DISSEMINATION: The results of this COS and CDS will be presented internationally at conferences and published in open access journals. Further dissemination through professional networks, the executive group and patient groups utilising patient friendly material will also be completed.
papers.title_zh: 急性左側大腸憩室炎核心描述指標與核心結果指標集之建立計畫書
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：憩室炎是全球常見的急診外科疾病。目前相關研究異質性高，導致對這類病人提供高品質、證據為本的照護仍具挑戰。因此我們旨在為急性左側大腸憩室炎建立一套核心結果指標集（COS）與核心描述指標集（CDS）。
方法：一個國際團隊依循 COMET（Core Outcome Measures in Effectiveness Trials）指引著手發展 COS 與 CDS。首先將完成領域長清單的製作，此階段將先進行系統性文獻回顧，以找出不同的描述指標與結果指標。接著將透過至少兩場病人焦點團體進行病人參與，以確保最終清單的完整性。描述指標與結果指標的最終清單，將透過多輪、連續性的國際電子化德菲法（Delphi）調查醫療專業人員進行優先排序，病人也將參與 COS 的發展過程。最後將召開共識會議，以確立 COS 的最終內容。
傳播：此 COS 與 CDS 的研究結果將於國際會議發表，並發表於開放取用期刊。另將透過專業網絡、執行小組及病人團體，利用病人易懂的材料進一步傳播。

papers.title: Notch Receptor 2 Drives Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition and M2-Like Macrophage Polarization in Human Colorectal Cancer Tissues and HCT116 Cells
papers.authors: Lin X, Wang S, Sun M, Zhang C, Wei C, Yang C
papers.abstract: Despite advances in understanding colorectal cancer (CRC) biology, how tumor-cell signaling coordinates epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) with macrophage polarization remains incompletely defined. We investigated whether NOTCH2 expression is associated with EMT and with a GATA3/IL-4-dependent macrophage-polarizing phenotype in CRC. NOTCH2 expression and prognostic associations were analyzed using TCGA data and validated in 20 paired CRC and adjacent normal tissue (ANT) specimens. Gain- and loss-of-function experiments in HCT116 cells assessed proliferation, migration, invasion, EMT markers, GATA3, and IL-4. A Transwell co-culture system containing transfected HCT116 cells and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) was used to evaluate CD206-positive M2-like macrophage polarization, and IL-4 neutralization was used to test the contribution of IL-4. NOTCH2 was increased in CRC tissues, and higher NOTCH2 expression was associated with poorer overall survival. NOTCH2 overexpression increased CRC-cell proliferation, migration, invasion, Vimentin, GATA3, and IL-4, while reducing E-cadherin; NOTCH2 silencing produced the opposite changes. Clinical tissues showed increased NOTCH2, GATA3, IL-4, CD163, and Vimentin, together with reduced E-cadherin. In co-culture, NOTCH2 overexpression increased the proportion of CD206-positive M2-like cells, whereas NOTCH2 knockdown reduced it. IL-4 neutralization significantly attenuated the increase in CD206-positive cells induced by NOTCH2 overexpression. These findings support associations among NOTCH2-associated malignant phenotypes, EMT, altered GATA3/IL-4 expression, and IL-4-dependent M2-like macrophage polarization in CRC, while direct transcriptional regulation of the GATA3/IL-4 axis remains to be established.

related.title_zh: Picroside II 透過調控 Notch1 訊號路徑抑制大腸直腸癌細胞進展
related.one_liner: 在 SW480 與 SW620 兩株大腸癌細胞中，比較不同濃度 Picroside II 處理與未處理，發現可劑量依賴性抑制增殖、遷移、侵襲及 Notch1 路徑表現。

related.title_zh: MiR-30a-5p 透過靶向Vimentin抑制ERK訊息傳遞路徑，抑制大腸直腸癌細胞之遷移與上皮間質轉化
related.one_liner: 在CRC細胞株中，比較miR-30a-5p過表現與對照，發現其可抑制遷移與EMT，機轉為靶向vimentin並抑制ERK路徑。

related.title_zh: KDM6B-DKK1軸的表觀遺傳活化透過Wnt/β-Catenin相關EMT促進大腸直腸癌腹膜轉移
related.one_liner: 在CRC細胞株與小鼠腹膜轉移模型中，比較DKK1 knockdown/過表現與對照，發現DKK1經KDM6B調控Wnt/β-catenin-EMT促進腹膜轉移。

papers.title_zh: NOTCH2受體驅動人類大腸直腸癌組織與HCT116細胞之上皮間質轉化（EMT）及M2樣巨噬細胞極化
papers.abstract_zh: 儘管對大腸直腸癌（CRC）生物學的理解已有進展，腫瘤細胞訊息傳遞如何協調上皮間質轉化（EMT）與巨噬細胞極化仍未完全釐清。本研究探討NOTCH2表現是否與EMT及GATA3/IL-4依賴性的巨噬細胞極化表型相關。利用TCGA資料分析NOTCH2表現與預後關聯，並以20對CRC與鄰近正常組織（ANT）檢體進行驗證。在HCT116細胞中進行功能增強與功能喪失實驗，評估增殖、遷移、侵襲、EMT標記、GATA3與IL-4。使用含轉染HCT116細胞與周邊血單核細胞（PBMCs）的Transwell共培養系統評估CD206陽性M2樣巨噬細胞極化，並以IL-4中和實驗測試IL-4的貢獻。結果顯示NOTCH2在CRC組織中表現增加，較高的NOTCH2表現與較差的整體存活相關。NOTCH2過表現增加CRC細胞增殖、遷移、侵襲、Vimentin、GATA3及IL-4，同時降低E-cadherin；NOTCH2靜默則產生相反變化。臨床組織顯示NOTCH2、GATA3、IL-4、CD163及Vimentin增加，E-cadherin降低。在共培養系統中，NOTCH2過表現增加CD206陽性M2樣細胞比例，而NOTCH2剔除則降低此比例。IL-4中和顯著減弱NOTCH2過表現所誘導的CD206陽性細胞增加。這些發現支持NOTCH2相關惡性表型、EMT、GATA3/IL-4表現改變，以及IL-4依賴性M2樣巨噬細胞極化之間的關聯，惟GATA3/IL-4軸的直接轉錄調控機制仍待建立。
papers.score_reason: 純細胞株與小規模配對組織之機轉研究，無臨床介入或治療意涵，對台灣大腸直腸外科臨床決策無直接實用性。
papers.relevance_why: 為基礎分子機轉研究（細胞株+20對組織驗證），非外科介入或可改變臨床處置的研究。
papers.one_liner: 在HCT116細胞與20對CRC/正常組織中，操控NOTCH2表現，發現其促進EMT並透過IL-4誘導M2樣巨噬細胞極化。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法，此為基礎機轉研究，尚無臨床應用或藥物標的證據。
